definitions.supplemental: Cf. hwisprian, hwistlian; and Icel. hvískra, hvísla to whisper.

quotations.old_english: Ágén mé hwǽstredun ealle fýnd mine
quotations.latin: adversum me susurrabant omnes inimici mei

quotations.citations: Mt. Kmbl. Lind. 20, 11: Lk. Skt. Lind. 19, 7: Jn. Skt. Lind. 6, 41, 61

source_text: hwástrian, hwǽstrian; p. ede To whisper, murmur, mutter :-- Ágén mé hwǽstredun ealle fýnd mine adversum me susurrabant omnes inimici mei, Ps. Lamb. 40, 8. Huǽstredon murmurabant, Mt. Kmbl. Lind. 20, 11: Lk. Skt. Lind. 19, 7: Jn. Skt. Lind. 6, 41, 61. Huǽstria murmurari, 6, 43. Huǽstrende murmurantem, 7, 32. [Cf. hwisprian, hwistlian; and Icel. hvískra, hvísla to whisper.]
